name: codemagic
description: Unofficial community MCP server for the Codemagic API: inspect apps and builds, trigger workflows, and manage CI with your own API token. Not affiliated with Codemagic.

interface.shortDescription: Unofficial: apps, builds, and workflows in Codemagic
interface.longDescription: An independent community integration, not made or endorsed by Codemagic or Nevercode Ltd. Connect your own token locally. Build, cache and artifact-link tools are on by default; switch to read-only or enable administration tools as you prefer.
defaultPrompt: List my Codemagic teams and apps.
Show the latest builds for my app.
